name: Barbell Silverback Shrug
cardText:
Barbell Silverback Shrug
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the Barbell with both hands in front just past shoulder width.
2
Bend forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
4
Release the shrug.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cardText:
Barbell Upright Row
Advanced
1
Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Barbell Shrug
cardText:
Barbell Shrug
Beginner
1
Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
2
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
3
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
4
Once the barbell is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.

name: Barbell Z Press
cardText:
Barbell Z Press
Advanced
1
Begin by sitting on the ground with your legs extended and a barbell in your hands, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
2
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, lift the barbell up from your chest and press it straight up above your head.
3
Lower the barbell back down to your chest.

name: Barbell High Pull
cardText:
Barbell High Pull
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
2
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
3
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
cardText:
Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
2
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
3
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
4
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.

name: Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug
cardText:
Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug
Beginner
1
Hold barbell behind you with arms at a 30 degree angle with your torso.
2
Shrug shoulders up and slightly back toward ears, keeping elbows locked.
3
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control to full stretch.

name: Barbell Behind The Back Shrug
cardText:
Barbell Behind The Back Shrug
Beginner
1
Hold barbell behind your hips with overhand grip, arms straight.
2
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears without bending elbows.
3
Lower slowly, maintaining tension in traps throughout the movement.

name: Barbell 30 Degree Shrug
cardText:
Barbell 30 Degree Shrug
Beginner
1
Hold barbell with a wide grip. Your arms should be at a roughly 30 degree angle.
2
Pull your shoulders towards your ears instead of straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Ez Bar Shrug
cardText:
Ez Bar Shrug
Beginner
1
Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
2
Bend down and grab the bar with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
3
Stand up straight, lifting the bar off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
4
Once the bar is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.

name: Ez Bar Upright Row
cardText:
Ez Bar Upright Row
Beginner
1
Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
cardText:
Trap Bar Shrug
Beginner
1
Stand inside trap bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed.
2
Elevate shoulders straight upward toward ears.
3
Pause briefly at top, squeezing traps.
4
Lower shoulders slowly to starting position.
